cleanlinessPerSalesExpansion.description: Maximum cleanliness added by each sales-floor expansion.

cleanlinessPerLevelAboveFloor.description: Maximum cleanliness added for each shop level above the level floor.

cleanlinessLevelFloor.description: Shop levels at or below this level add no maximum cleanliness.

trashPenalty.description: Cleanliness points lost for each piece of loose trash.

dirtPenalty.description: Cleanliness points lost for each dirt mark.

cleanlinessJudgeMs.description: Running time before a customer first judges store cleanliness.

trashDropChance.description: Chance a customer drops one piece of trash during their visit.

trashDropWalkMs.description: Earliest and latest walking time before a customer drops trash.

upsetReputationLoss.description: Store reputation lost when a customer is upset by cleanliness.

walkOutReputationLoss.description: Store reputation lost when a customer leaves over cleanliness.

trashcanReachPx.description: Distance from a trashcan edge used to test player interaction.

trashPickupAheadPx.description: Distance ahead of the player's feet used to find loose trash.

trashPickupReachPx.description: Maximum distance from the pickup point to loose trash.

blockedSpotSearchStepPx.description: Distance between candidate floor spots when fixtures cover trash.

blockedSpotSearchMaxRings.description: Maximum search rings used to move trash away from a new fixture.

trashDepth.description: Draw depth for loose trash so people, crates, and fixtures cover it.

trashScale.description: Display scale for loose trash sprites.

trashHighlightDepth.description: Draw depth for the trash highlight above the shop floor.

scavengersUpsetPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which scavengers become upset.

scavengersWalkOutPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which scavengers leave.

civilianUpsetPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which regular customers become upset.

civilianWalkOutPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which regular customers leave.

mercenariesUpsetPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which mercenaries become upset.

mercenariesWalkOutPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which mercenaries leave.

explorersUpsetPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which explorers become upset.

explorersWalkOutPercent.description: Cleanliness percentage range below which explorers leave.
